note: What a server sends to put a turret on the field. In everything observed it arrives only inside EnterSight, and the channel and delivery recorded here are those of the message carrying it.

fields.name: turret
fields.note: The name the turret answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: unknown1
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It is 64 where a unit, a turret or a prop is put on the field and zero where a champion is, though the name beside it opens with 64 in every one of those.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this turret is called, so a client can tell one from another. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

bits.name: targetable
bits.note: Set where anything may aim at it.

fields.name: targetableBy
fields.note: Which sides may aim at it. The bits within are undetermined.
